cohort: Singleton pregnancies with breech presentation at term
finding: While composite adverse obstetrical outcomes are similar between offering vaginal breech delivery or cesarean delivery for breech presentation, short-term, non-severe adverse neonatal outcomes are significantly increased when vaginal breech delivery is routinely offered.
mod_finding: Short-term, non-severe adverse neonatal outcomes are significantly increased when vaginal breech delivery is routinely offered compared to cesarean delivery for breech presentations.
